story.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Identified as Security Risk Before Incident
story.summary: The co-pilot of a FlyDubai flight, who allegedly attacked the captain with an axe, has been identified as an Omani national. He was previously suspended by Oman Air due to security concerns. Emirati authorities have described the incident as an attempted terrorist attack.

timeline_highlights.title: Investigation Launched into Low-Flying Jets Over Cape Town Stadium
timeline_highlights.summary: South African aviation authorities are investigating a low-altitude flyover by two Airlink passenger jets over DHL Stadium in Cape Town. The incident occurred before a rugby match between the Springboks and the All Blacks and has raised safety concerns following a viral video showing the jets barely clearing the stadium.

The incident took place before a rugby match.
South African aviation authorities are reviewing the flyover.

timeline_highlights.title: Investigation Underway After Co-Pilot Stabs Pilot on Israel-Bound Flight
timeline_highlights.summary: An investigation is ongoing into a serious incident involving a FlyDubai flight from the UAE to Israel, where one pilot stabbed another and allegedly attempted to crash the aircraft. The plane made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stating that the situation is being treated as a potential terror attack. Passengers reported alarming scenes during the cockpit altercation.
key_facts: One pilot stabbed another on a FlyDubai flight to Israel.
The incident occurred mid-air, leading to an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.
Israeli officials are investigating the possibility of a terror plot.

revisions.title: Investigation Underway into Co-pilot's Attack on Israel-bound Flydubai Flight
revisions.summary: An Omani co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain of a Flydubai flight bound for Israel in an apparent attempt to crash the plane. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that the co-pilot had undergone radical Islamist indoctrination and exhibited suicidal tendencies. Passengers intervened to restrain the attacker, and the flight was diverted safely. Investigations are ongoing to determine the co-pilot's motives and how he was cleared to fly.

timeline_highlights.title: Pilot Describes Co-Pilot Attack During Flydubai Flight
timeline_highlights.summary: Flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar recounted a traumatic incident where he was attacked by his co-pilot during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Despite being wounded, he stated that he felt compelled to protect the passengers on board. The attack occurred earlier this week, raising serious concerns about cockpit safety.

timeline_highlights.title: Pilot Recalls Heroic Actions During Flydubai Cockpit Attack
timeline_highlights.summary: Capt. Smit Machchhar, recovering in a hospital, described his harrowing experience during an attack on a Flydubai flight. He recounted how he fought to regain control of the cockpit, realizing that if he did not act, the passengers' lives were at risk. His actions, which included opening the cockpit door to allow passengers to assist, have led to him being hailed as a hero.

He opened the cockpit door to allow passengers to help overpower the co-pilot.

related_stories.summary: Newly released police bodycam footage captures the arrest of Luigi Mangione at a McDonald's in Pennsylvania. Mangione has pleaded guilty to federal charges related to the incident.
